title: Extracellular Fluid Extraction in Zebrafish Brain Tissue and Samples
author: Caio Maximino

steps.title: Prepare ice‑cold euthanasia bath
steps.instruction: Add ice to a beaker containing at least 1 L system water, chill until the temperature is between 0 °C and 4 °C, and place a tea strainer above the ice layer for animal placement.

steps.title: Euthanize zebrafish in ice water
steps.instruction: Sacrifice each zebrafish by immersion in the ice‑cold water bath prepared above.

steps.title: Chill animals in strainer
steps.instruction: Transfer animals individually onto the tea strainer, keep them in contact with the cold water for at least 5 min; if any movement is observed, extend the chilling time until motion ceases.

steps.title: Transfer to dissection dish
steps.instruction: Move each chilled animal to a 10 × 35 mm Petri dish (Nunc, catalog #150318) filled with the prepared dissection solution (artificial cerebrospinal fluid).

steps.title: Decapitate animal
steps.instruction: Using Fisherbrand dissecting scissors (catalog #15277168), cut cleanly through the pectoral girdle immediately anterior to the articulation of the pectoral fin, severing the heart.

steps.title: Expose brain by dissection
steps.instruction: With the same scissors, remove skin and cranial bones to expose the brain, beginning at the junction of medulla and spinal cord to avoid forebrain damage; gently lift the medulla with an insulin needle and cut ventral cranial‑nerve roots using microdissection pincers.

steps.title: Prepare Tris extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 4.44 g Tris‑HCl (P212121) and 2.65 g Tris base (Fisher Scientific catalog #BP152‑1) in 1 L double‑distilled water; adjust pH to 8.0 with acid or base as needed.

steps.title: Add salts to extraction buffer
steps.instruction: To the Tris buffer add 5.2596 g sodium chloride (P212121), 0.27745 g calcium chloride, and 0.30733 g glutathione.

steps.title: Prepare artificial CSF
steps.instruction: Dissolve in 1 L double‑distilled water the following: 7.65564 g sodium chloride (P212121), 0.1491026 g potassium chloride (P212121), 0.1701 g potassium phosphate monobasic (P212121), 0.240732 g magnesium sulfate heptahydrate (Merck MilliporeSigma catalog #M2773), 1.80156 g glucose (P212121), 0.27745 g calcium chloride, and 1.68014 g sodium bicarbonate (Merck MilliporeSigma catalog #S6014).

steps.title: Store dissection solution
steps.instruction: Keep the artificial CSF at 4 °C in the refrigerator and use within 30 days.

steps.title: Incubate brain tissue
steps.instruction: Place one brain (or fraction) into a 1.5 mL microtube already filled with extraction fluid, keep the tube on ice or a 4 °C fridge, and incubate for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Proceed to downstream analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the extracted extracellular fluid by sensitive techniques such as HPLC to quantify neurotransmitter content; the measured levels represent extracellular concentrations.
